title: Paul Jones plays I Got Rhythm; Chester Brown's acoustic guitar
summary: Paul Jones took seven or eight choruses on I Got Rhythm over an hour and a half and Chester Brown soloed single-note on acoustic guitar in a Charlie Christian style.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What tune were they playing?
First they was playing "I Got Rhythm." They played that about an hour-and-a-half -- heh-heh! He used to take about 7 or 8 choruses on it.
Who is that?
Paul Jones. Toby, he played again. And Page, he took some on the bass. Then Chester took some on guitar, because all of them played solos...
What kind of guitar solos was Chester taking? Were they single-note solos or were they chord solos?
Single notes. He was playing like Charlie Christian's style.
but he hadn't heard Charlie Christian at that time, I
Phillips - 187
guess -- by '37. That would have been before.
No, he hadn't heard it, but that's the style he was playing.
Acoustic or electric guitar?
It was acoustic. I don't think electric guitars came out until Charlie came out.
Eddie Durham was playing some...
Yeah, I know him.
And T-Bone Walker was into it kind of early.
Yeah, I know those cats. Eddie Durham was a helluva trombone player, too.
Anyway, you were saying Chester took a solo.
Chester. He could play, too, man. Chester played, man. Then later on he got an amplifier for his box.
In later times. But at point he was taking a solo on acoustic guitar.
Yes.
